newsitem.title: USA: Colorado cattle trading active, top at $113 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Colorado cattle trading active, top at $113 - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter cattle active Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers not established live, carcass basis sales $1.00 per cwt higher than last week, USDA said.
Sales reported on 4,400 steers and 4,500 heifers.
Slaughter steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1225 lbs 69.50. Carcass basis: Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 113.00.
Slaughter heifers: Carcass basis: Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1125 lbs 113.00, few 112.00.
Confirmed Sales: 8,900 Last Week: 18,700 Last Year: 1,950
Week to Date : 8,900 Last Week: 19,100 Last year: 5,400
